summary: Test-data/tooling only. No src/ change, no trust boundary: the generator's inputs are committed constants (seeded case list, range palette); it reads no argv/env beyond the standard main-module check, makes no network calls, spawns no processes, and writes only the fixed path tests/advice/fixtures/equity-multiway-reference.json resolved from the repo root. The only dynamic import is vite runnerImport of the in-repo src/engine/hand-evaluator.ts. mulberry32 is used solely for reproducible reference sampling, where fairness and security do not depend on it, so it needs no CSPRNG. The rejection-sampling loop is bounded (throws after 1000*trials rejections). The tests only read the committed fixture. generate-reference.js only gains two exports with no behaviour change. No new dependencies.
